prompts.title: Black Panther: Deep Jungle
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic cinematic portrait of a man. The final result should feel like a high-end, film-grade superhero scene set in a dense jungle environment.
Location & Environment:
A deep, lush tropical rainforest filled with dense foliage, large glossy leaves, hanging vines, and layered vegetation. The environment is slightly misty, enhancing depth and atmosphere. Background remains dark and immersive, suggesting nighttime or heavy canopy shade. Soft beams of cool moonlight filter through the trees, creating a mysterious cinematic ambiance with subtle fog diffusion.
Subject & Pose:
The subject stands centered in frame with a strong, grounded, heroic stance.
Upright posture with squared shoulders
Body facing forward with a slight turn toward the right
Left hand holding a sleek feline-inspired helmet near the hip
Right arm relaxed but powerful at the side
Pose conveys dominance, calm authority, and readiness
Facial Features & Expression:
Maintain exact identity from reference image
Strong jawline, natural skin texture with visible pores
Short, neatly styled hair with subtle volume
Light, realistic stubble
Expression: serious, intense, focused
Eyes looking directly at camera, conveying leadership and control
Outfit & Suit Design:
A futuristic, form-fitting, matte-black tactical suit:
Intricate micro-texture with fine mesh patterns
Geometric paneling across chest, arms, and torso
Sleek, athletic silhouette emphasizing muscular structure
Metallic silver accents forming a sharp, claw-like necklace design
Subtle silver detailing on forearms, gloves, and seams
Material appears advanced, durable, and high-tech with realistic depth
Helmet (Handheld):
Feline-inspired, matte black helmet with smooth contours
Minimal but sharp silver line detailing
Angular, stealth-like design with a powerful presence
Appears solid, heavy, and technologically advanced
Firm natural grip in left hand (no floating or distortion)
Camera Angle & Framing:
Slightly low-angle shot (heroic perspective)
Medium to three-quarter framing (upper thigh to head)
Centered composition with balanced negative space
Subject occupies ~65–70% of frame height
Lighting & Mood:
Low-key cinematic lighting
Cool blue-green ambient tones from jungle environment
Soft rim light outlining shoulders and suit edges
Gentle highlights revealing suit texture
Deep shadows for contrast and drama
Subtle volumetric light rays through foliage
No harsh flash or flat lighting
Color Grading:
Dark, moody cinematic palette
Dominant tones: deep green, teal, charcoal black
Controlled contrast with rich shadows and crisp highlights
No oversaturation or unnatural hues
Technical Details:
Ultra-realistic, 8K resolution
Sharp focus on subject, shallow depth of field
Soft background bokeh with detailed foliage layering
Professional cinematic photography style
Lens: 50–85mm, f/1.8–f/2.8
High dynamic range 
Aspect ratio 4:5

images.alt: Gemini AI Generated Image: A hyper-realistic, cinematic portrait features a muscular man standing confidently amidst a dense, moonlit jungle environment. He is wearing a highly detailed, form-fitting black bodysuit reminiscent of the Black Panther superhero costume, characterized by intricate woven textures, geometric patterns, and a distinctive silver claw-tooth necklace. The subject has short, dark hair, a well-groomed beard, and maintains a serious, intense gaze directed forward. In his right hand, he holds a matching matte black helmet with silver accents. The setting is lush with large tropical leaves framing the figure, and the scene is illuminated by cool, atmospheric lighting that highlights the texture of the suit and creates a moody, heroic ambiance.

prompts.title: Venom action
prompts.prompt: Create a 16K ultra-realistic, cinematic Hollywood action scene using the uploaded reference image of the same young man (100% exact facial match, do not alter face shape, skin tone, facial structure, or identity in any way). The man is captured in a dynamic crouched superhero landing pose, one knee bent forward, one hand firmly pressed against the concrete floor, the other arm extended backward for balance. His expression is intense, focused, and fearless, with sharp eyes locked forward. He wearing a dark fitted jacket over a neutral t-shirt, slim dark jeans, and rugged boots, all slightly worn for realism. From his back, a Venom-like symbiote entity violently erupts, partially merged with his body. The symbiote appears glossy black, organic yet metallic, with long twisting tendrils and sharp, claw-like extensions spreading outward. A semi-formed monstrous head emerges over his shoulder, featuring razor-sharp teeth, an exaggerated grin, wet reflective textures, and glowing white eyes, creating a menacing presence. The symbiote feels alive, mid-motion, as if expanding and reacting to the environment. Environment & Setting The scene takes place inside a large abandoned industrial warehouse with high ceilings, steel beams, tall grid windows, and concrete flooring. The space is filled with cinematic fog and dust particles floating in the air. Sparks and debris scatter near the ground, suggesting recent impact or action. Lighting & Color Tone Strong cinematic lighting contrast: Warm orange sparks and firelight from the left Cool blue rim light and practical lights from the right Volumetric light beams cut through the fog from overhead windows Subtle lens flares, motion blur, and light streaks enhance action intensity Realistic reflections on the wet concrete floor beneath the character Film-grade color grading with teal-orange Hollywood tone Camera & Style Low-angle, wide cinematic shot Shallow depth of field with sharp subject focus Hyper-detailed textures (skin pores, fabric fibers, symbiote surface) Photorealistic CGI blended seamlessly with live-action realism Subtle film grain for a blockbuster movie look Quality & Constraints Ultra-detailed, photorealistic, cinematic, high contrast, IMAX-level realism, dynamic motion energy. Create Image in 4:5 Aspect ratio. Do NOT change the face or identity. Face must remain exactly the same as the reference image. No exaggeration or stylization of facial features.
